title: Implement GCS engine primitives conformance slice
body:
## Summary

- add runtime-dependency-free branded fixed-point, typed-ID, and persisted-enum primitives to `@gcs/gcs-engine`
- add a pinned GCS v5.44.0 / Toolbox v2.15.0 Go JSONL oracle and deterministic TypeScript-to-Go differential tests
- extend built-package smoke coverage, documentation, MPL-2.0 attribution, and the canonical Docker gate

## Reproduction and verification

Before this change, the package exposed document parsing/serialization but none of the primitive API or pinned conformance oracle required by #1. The new unit and differential suites exercise the missing surface and protect signed boundaries, crypto-only TID generation, strict enum parsing, visible compatibility diagnostics, and exponent precision policy.

Fresh canonical verification:

```sh
docker compose build toolchain
docker compose run --rm toolchain pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
docker compose run --rm toolchain pnpm check
```

Results:

- 149 package unit tests passed
- both pinned Go oracle suites passed
- 25 document conformance tests passed
- 23 primitive differential tests passed
- build and built-package smoke passed
- package production dependency listing is empty
- production audit reports no known vulnerabilities

## Implementation checkpoints

- `3255c90` stable primitive oracle protocol
- `bd5b8f1` pinned Go fixed-point behavior
- `b3d071d` fixed-point parsing and formatting
- `10a6c12` fixed-point arithmetic and rounding
- `656a9c7` typed identifiers and cryptographic generation
- `8b52caf` persisted enum primitives and diagnostics
- `7d15647` deterministic primitive conformance harness
- `95e4964` package/docs/licensing/canonical-gate integration
- `7ce5b24` exponent precision policy characterization

## Compatibility and scope

- existing parser/serializer sources, tests, fixtures, and unknown-field behavior are unchanged
- no production Go or JavaScript dependency was added
- no host-specific GCS path, secret, UI work, or `AGENTS.md` edit was introduced
- the optional external corpus was not run and remains outside the canonical gate

Closes #1.
